short: The backbone of the Luftwaffe's fighter force and the most produced fighter aircraft in history.
full:
The Messerschmitt Bf 109 was a revolutionary German fighter introduced in 1937. Designed around an all-metal monocoque structure, retractable landing gear, and a closed canopy, it represented the first of a new generation of modern monoplane fighters. It first saw combat with the Condor Legion during the Spanish Civil War and quickly established itself as the dominant interceptor over Europe during the early years of the Second World War, gaining notoriety during the Battle of Britain.

Constantly upgraded to maintain parity with Allied fighters, the Bf 109 underwent numerous redesigns that culminated in the heavily armed G and K variants. By the end of the conflict, more than thirty-three thousand had been produced, making it the most manufactured fighter aircraft in history. After the war, foreign-built derivatives continued to be produced and flown in countries including Czechoslovakia and Spain until 1965.
